text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can produce paintings, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and use it to create something new. However, many people believe there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, simply recognizes patterns and copies styles. While AI-generated art can be impressive, it often lacks true feeling. For now, AI seems to work best as a helpful tool that supports human creativity rather than replacing it.
